title: Azure Cloud Specialist
description:
Brinner du för molninfrastruktur och vill bidra till en hållbar och modern IT-miljö inom en samhällsviktig verksamhet i Stockholm?
 



  





 Vi söker nu en Azure Cloud Specialist som vill arbeta med avancerad teknik i en organisation som kombinerar trygghet och långsiktighet med innovation och framtidstänk. Som nyckelperson i vår kunds satsning på en smart och effektiv hybridmiljö får du möjligheten att både påverka strategiska vägval och vara hands-on i utvecklingen av deras molnplattform.
 



  





 Tjänsten börjar som ett konsultuppdrag där tanken är att anställningen senare ska gå över till vår kund.
 



  





 Som konsult på Eccera får du en trygg anställning och samlar på dig värdefull arbetslivserfarenhet på uppdrag hos våra kunder. Din konsultchef stöttar dig i din utveckling där du hela tiden fyller på med nya erfarenheter och kunskaper. En utmärkt möjlighet att göra karriär.
 



  





**Dina arbetsuppgifter** 




 Som Azure Cloud Specialist blir du en del av vår kunds infrastrukturteam med hög teknisk kompetens. Du arbetar nära verksamheten och arkitekter för att implementera, drifta och vidareutveckla molnbaserade infrastruktur, både i Azure och on-prem-miljö.
 



  





 Du bidrar till att säkerställa att allt fungerar på ett effektivt, säkert och framtidssäkrat sätt.
 



  





*Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:* 



* Implementera och utveckla molnbaserade infrastrukturlösningar i Azure
* Stödja och utveckla hybridinfrastrukturen i nära samarbete med teamet
* Arbeta med säkerhetslösningar, automation, kostnadsoptimering och nya funktioner i molnplattformen



  





**Din profil** 




  





*Krav:* 



* Minst 7 års erfarenhet i liknande roller
* Certifiering inom Microsoft Azure (t.ex. Azure Administrator Associate eller Security Engineer Associate)
* Mycket goda kunskaper inom Azure-plattformens kärnkomponenter: Compute, nätverk, lagring, identitet, säkerhet och automation
* Erfarenhet av Azure Virtual Desktop, Application Gateway, Application Proxy och Intune
* Vana vid hybridmiljöer och god kännedom om kostnadsstyrning i Azure
* Färdigheter i PowerShell och hantering av Conditional Access
* Erfarenhet av Entra ID och Active Directory
* God kommunikationsförmåga på svenska och engelska



  





*Meriterande:* 



* Kunskap inom DNS, Linuxmiljöer, Terraform eller annan IaC-lösning
* Erfarenhet av certifikatshantering, PKI, ADCS



  





**Vad vi erbjuder** 




 På Eccera får du de verktyg du behöver för att nå dina mål. Vi erbjuder alla våra konsulter kvalificerade utbildningar och certifieringar inom den senaste tekniken. Vi sätter stort värde på att våra medarbetare hela tiden ska fortsätta att utvecklas. Därför erbjuder vi dig möjligheten att lägga upp en individuell utbildningsplan, där vi bekostar såväl studiematerial som själva certifieringarna. Under din utveckling kommer vi matcha din kompetens mot rätt uppdrag i takt med att du avancerar.

title: Finance & BizOps, Marketing
description:
**TL;DR:** 
 Be the strategic finance partner to the Marketing Org. You will own the financial architecture behind every marketing dollar. You’ll build the models, measurement systems, and operating rhythms that ensure every investment compounds into growth. This is an ownership seat with direct executive visibility, not a reporting function.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable lets anyone and everyone build software with any language. From solopreneurs to Fortune 100 teams, millions of people use Lovable to transform raw ideas into real products - fast. We are at the forefront of a foundational shift in software creation, which means you have an unprecedented opportunity to change the way the digital world works. Lovable-built applications and websites are visited hundreds of millions of times a month, and our enterprise footprint is compounding fast. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re a small, talent-dense team building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We seek out people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
**Growth marketing strategist:** 
 You treat marketing spend as a portfolio of investments, not a cost center. You can decompose a blended CAC, trace attribution across channels, build cohort-level payback models, and tell a CMO exactly where the next marginal dollar should go and where to cut. You have an informed opinion on how brand spend, paid acquisition, and organic loops interact, and you back it with data.
   

  

**Technical and data-driven** 
 : Strong analytical skills, with expert Excel modeling skills as table stakes. Comfortable with data (SQL, HEX, BI tools, or equivalent). You use AI tools and agents to automate work and move faster. Preference for technical degrees or deep technical exposure.
   

  

**Service-first partner** 
 : You bring a proactive, "can-do" attitude to every interaction and own the operationally tedious work required for clean handoffs between teams.
   

  

**High-slope learner** 
 : You learn faster than anyone around you, take ownership immediately, and thrive in low-structure environments. You go from 0→1 and then 1→10.
   

  

**Experience** 
 : 4+ years of relevant experience supporting Marketing leadership. Strong candidates have a foundation in investment banking, private equity, venture capital, or management consulting, combined with operational experience at a high-growth startup, AI company, or scaled technology company. You learn fast, take ownership, and operate well in environments where the playbook doesn't exist yet. Bachelor's degree required.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Drive marketing efficiency & planning:** 
 Own the financial operating plan for Marketing - budget allocation, campaign ROI analysis, and investment tradeoffs to fuel B2C growth while maintaining unit economics discipline.
   

  

**Build and own channel-level unit economics:** 
 Develop and own the CAC, LTV, and payback models that drive investment decisions at the channel and cohort level. Tie spend to acquisition, retention, and revenue so that marketing leadership and finance are operating from one shared source of truth. Pressure-test assumptions continuously — what's working, what's not, and where the next dollar should go.
   

  

**Connect marketing performance to company outcomes:** 
 Work across the organization to ensure marketing investment ties to measurable business results. Analyze market trends, competitive spend, and channel dynamics to inform forward-looking strategy and ensure capital is deployed where it compounds.
   

  

**Support experimentation, reporting, and forecasting:** 
 Partner with Marketing to size tests, set success metrics, and forecast impact on growth and unit economics. Create clear, repeatable reporting to track performance, targets, variance, and learnings that translate into action.
   

  

**Accelerate with AI:** 
 Use AI agents and automation to collapse the time between question and answer. You're expected to continuously push what's possible, replacing manual processes with scalable infrastructure that moves at Lovable's speed.
   

  

**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Quantitative Risk Analysts, Credit Stress Testing and IFRS9
description:
**Job ID: 1480**
 We are looking for a Quantitative Risk Analyst to our dynamic team. In this recruitment we put great value in you as a person and therefore encourage all levels to apply. The role is permanent and can be based in Stockholm, Helsinki and Warsaw.
   

  

**About Our Team**
 Meet the Credit Stress Testing & IFRS9 Models team in Risk Models, Group Risk. Our role is to upscale Nordea’s models and frameworks for internal expected loss. You will cooperate closely with your colleagues across the bank and you will have great possibilities to develop your skills within credit risk area – a field which is in high focus in Nordea. Our team have an open and inspiring atmosphere where we value being good colleagues. The team has a broad range of seniority levels which is why we welcome different seniorities to join since we have capacity to both train and onboard you, but also to learn more from you. You will report to Head of Stress Testing & EWI Models, who is based in Stockholm.
   

  

 Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
**Main responsibilities in this role:**
* Design and implement large datasets to solve complex problems
* Develop quantitative models within the IFRS9 and stress testing suite of credit risk models
* Develop Python based tools to simulate portfolio impact for various scenario analysis, including stress testing and macro sensitivities
* Build relationships with different stakeholders within and outside the bank to facilitate understanding on our models and framework
* Provide sharp data analytics to contribute to key decisions

title: Timanställning vårdadministratör
company: Moment Hälsa - från tanke till handling
description:
Moment Psykologi & Psykiatri förstärker nu sitt team med rekrytering av en serviceinriktad timanställd vårdadministratör. Trivs du som bäst i en verksamhet som erbjuder stort inflytande, nära ledarskap och korta beslutsvägar?
   

  

 Moment är en verksamhet med patienters bästa i fokus. Här jobbar vi tillsammans för att patienterna ska få ett gott omhändertagande från första kontakt och igenom hela vårdkedjan. Som vårdadministratör är du en nyckelperson.
   

  

**Om verksamheten**
 Moment Psykologi & Psykiatri en verksamhet vars målgrupp är barn, ungdomar och vuxna. Våra uppdragsgivare är offentlig sektor, företag och privatpersoner. Verksamheten i Stockholm bedrivs i en representativ mottagningslokal där vi utför psykologisk och medicinsk behandling samt neuropsykiatriska utredningar. Vi har ett unikt team av specialister bestående av psykiatriker, psykologer och sjuksköterska som träffar våra patienter både på mottagningen och digitalt.
   

  

 Vår vision är ett samhälle med bättre hälsa där alla får rätt vård i rätt tid. Omtanke, kunskap och generositet genomsyrar verksamheten.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 Som timanställd vårdadministratör hos oss arbetar du tillsammans med kollegor i team vårdadministration som ansvarar för vårdadministrationen på våra huvudmottagningar och filialmottagningar. Arbetet består övergripande av remisshantering, kallelse-bokning, telefoni, chatt, och säkerställande av rätt registreringar m.m. Som vårdadministratör har du mycket kontakt med patienter och deras anhöriga samt med kollegor. Arbetet innebär fokus på ett gott bemötande och kundvård i alla kontaktytor med patienter och kunder.
   

  

 Det finns hög grad av struktur och välfungerande arbetsrutiner. Moment är en kvalitetsmedveten organisation och här förväntas du bidra i det ständiga förbättringsarbetet.
   

  

****Vem är du?****
 Vi söker dig med arbetserfarenhet av vårdadministration inom hälso- och/eller sjukvård, gärna från privat sektor.
   

  

 Som person är du nyfiken, konstruktiv problemlösare och har en starkt vilja att lära dig nya saker. Du har ett positivt förhållningssätt, är trygg i din roll och kan vara både uppgifts- och relationsorienterad. Du uppskattar och bidrar till en god arbetsmiljö och ständig förbättring av verksamheten. Du är van att arbeta effektivt i ett högt tempo - och alltid med patientens bästa i fokus. Du tycker om att ge god service och är självständig, ansvarstagande och noggrann. Du gillar förändringar, är flexibel och kan ställa om arbetsflöden och rutiner utifrån verksamhetens behov.
   

  

 God systemvana och förmåga att snabbt sätta sig in i nya IT-system är ett krav. Erfarenhet av journalsystemet Webdoc, vårdkommunikationssystemet Doctrin och Excel är särskilt meriterande, liksom intresse för och kompetens inom AI-stödda arbetssätt.
   

  

 Du har mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift, samt kunna tala engelska obehindrat.
   

  

 Erfarenhet från arbete inom privat sektor; företagshälsovård, BUMM, BUP, vårdcentral eller liknande är meriterande.
   

  

 Förstås ser vi gärna att du delar vår värdegrund:
   

  

**VI GER**
* Vi omsätter högspecialiserad evidensbaserad vård till handfasta råd och verktyg
* Vi är fokuserade på utveckling och arbetsglädje för våra medarbetare
* Vi ger vård som ger hållbara resultat
* Vi delar med oss av kunskap och stödjer varandra kollegialt


**VI LÄR**
* Vi anstränger oss för att ta reda på ny kunskap
* Vi tar del av vetenskapliga rön och utvecklar våra metoder kontinuerligt
* Vi bedriver förbättringsarbete som en naturlig del av vardagen


**VI GÖR SKILLNAD**
* Våra tjänster skapar kännbar förändring och mätbara resultat
* Våra tjänster ger effekt som håller i sig över tid
* Vi skapar en branschförebild och förbättrar vården


**Vi erbjuder dig**

 Moment grundades 2010 och leds sedan starten värderingsstyrt med stort fokus på att skapa samhällsnytta.

För att vara aktuell för tjänsten ska du vara tillgänglig för introduktion under augusti och kunna jobba minst 75 % under september.

 , vi intervjuar löpande så skicka gärna in din ansökan snarast vid intresse för timanställnings tjänsten! Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

title: Aftersales Manager
description:
**The Company**
 We are Zeekr, built on a decade of European experience. We are a premium electric vehicle and technology solutions brand from Geely Holding Group, one of world’s largest automotive companies. Our goal and vision is to accelerate the shift to fully electrified mobility. We are committed to driving the future of transportation with cutting-edge technology and a customer-centric approach.
   

  

**The role**
 As Aftersales Lead you will build and grow our after sales business at ZEEKR NSC in Sweden. Built strong relationships with our customers by offering outstanding service and guidance through the chain and involvement into product and service development. The After Sales Lead is a vital part of the Leadership team in Sweden to steer to next level, reports to the Head of Country and works closely with the respective teams from Zeekr Europe located nearby in Amsterdam.
   

  

**This is what you will do:**
* Lead the After Sales Team in the NSC.
* Build and Strengthen Relationships: Foster and maintain strong relationships with the aftersales teams within our network across the country. Collaborate to ensure alignment with our after-sales service standards and customer satisfaction goals.
* Implement and monitor the implementation of the after-sales strategies developed and delivered by Zeekr Service Network Development, with the aim of improving customer satisfaction, customer experience, loyalty and retention. Encourage initiatives to improve service efficiency, streamline processes and reduce downtime for customers.
* Provide Training and Support: Conduct training sessions directly or through our partner for after sales teams on new products, technical updates, and service protocols. Offer continuous support and guidance, addressing technical inquiries and service-related challenges.
* Monitor Performance Metrics : Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for after sales services or service training. Analyze data to identify trends, areas for improvement, and opportunities to enhance the overall after-sales experience.
* Resolve Escalated Issues: Act as a point of contact for escalated after-sales issues, working closely to resolve customer concerns promptly and effectively. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure swift resolution of technical and service-related challenges.
* Collaborate on Product Improvement: Gather feedback from after sales teams and customers to contribute to the continuous improvement of our products and services. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement product enhancements based on after-sales insights.
* Active Warranty Management follow up: Responsible for coordinating and overseeing first line warranty processes within the NSC. Monitor OEM warranty processes, service bulletins and the WPPM guidelines. Follow up warranty claim performance, accuracy, timelines. Coordinate action plans if required in the network.
* Active Technical support follow up: Responsible and ensure quick, accurate and professional support for technical issues, diagnostics and product related inquiries to maintain high service quality across the network.
* Active Parts & Logistics Management follow up: Responsible for coordinating, supporting and optimizing all first-line parts related processes within the NSC.
* Compliance: Adhering to regulatory requirements and industry standards.
* Quality and after-sales standard Assurance Lead: Ensure all dealership authorized service workshops operate in full compliance with the Zeekr quality, service and operational standards.


**To be successful in the role you will demonstrate:**
* Proven track record of successful after sales business development.
* Proven experiences on Dealer Management.
* Sufficient knowledge on P&L, Proven experiences in financial planning and execution.
* Proven experiences in After Sales operations management.
* Sufficient knowledge and understanding of customer experience, customer satisfaction and customer approach.
* Leading team with clear R&R, goals/objectives.
* Engaging & developing people, diving high-performance culture.
* Problem-solving, critical thinking and decision-making skills.
* Encouraging collaborations and fostering heathy work environment.
* Strong management level reporting and presentations.
* Extensive experience in after-sales management within the automotive industry, working for an OEM or experience gained by dealer holdings.
* Experienced in managing an OEM workshop, where, among others, vehicle preparation, including accessory installation, repairs, warranty services, and diagnostic work, contributes to operational efficiency and positive business outcome.
* The ability to steer the detail of today and anticipate on what is coming up next.
* Strong technical understanding of electric vehicles and automotive systems.
* Flexible and able to adapt quickly to changes.
* Proven experience in building relationships for a premium automotive brand.
* Entrepreneurial skills to always improve from within by fostering and nurturing ideas from the team.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and effective communication in native language and English.
* Ability to lead with trust and care, adapt to a fast-paced environment, and embrace diversity.
* Strong team player and able to lead the team in a constructive, positive way to be able to achieve the team objectives, and individual team member objectives.


**Please submit your CV in English**
 To thrive at Zeekr we believe that you have the courage to lead with trust and care and you don’t mind getting your hands dirty. You are highly innovative and have a great ability to adapt and perform in a constantly changing, fast-paced, highly demanding work environment. Like us, you believe it’s important to have a passion to work in an international and multicultural environment with the desire and ability to embrace the diversity of people, perspectives, and styles.
   

  

*Apply today, we will perform ongoing selection during the application period. We look forward to hearing from you.*
*Please note that due to GDPR regulations we can only accept applications sent through the recruitment system, not via email or other channels. We do not accept applications submitted by external recruitment companies.*

title: Account Executive - Sweden
description:
Account Executive – Sweden
   

  

**Location:** 
 Sweden (Stockholm or Goteborg preferred)
   

  

**Employment type:** 
 Full-time
   

  

**Working model:** 
 Hybrid
   

  

**About Neural Concept**
 Engineering is at an inflection point. The teams defining the next generation of aircraft, electric vehicles, and consumer products are not just designing faster — they are designing fundamentally differently, with AI embedded at the core of their workflows.
   

  

 Neural Concept builds the Engineering AI platform that makes this possible. We help the world's leading engineering teams accelerate development, improve product outcomes, and scale engineering capacity — turning months of simulation into days, and engineering intuition into data-driven insight.
   

  

 We work with elite engineering teams in Automotive, Aerospace, High-Tech and Electronics, and advanced manufacturing, where the stakes are high, the complexity is rising, and the pressure to innovate has never been greater. We are changing how engineers work. Come build that future with us.
   

  

 The role
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Account Executive to develop strategic customers and prospects establishing Engineering AI as a new standard for product development. You will own the full enterprise sales cycle, from identifying prospects, to advancing opportunities, closing and expanding strategic customers. Working together with a cross-functional team, you will lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving engineering teams, IT, procurement and senior executives.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Build and execute a territory and account strategy for selected engineering-driven companies.
* Generate new opportunities through targeted prospecting, executive outreach, events and partners.
* Develop strong relationships with customer stakeholders in engineering and IT.
* Own the complete sales process from discovery and qualification through negotiation and closing.
* Build executive sponsors across customer organizations.
* Create compelling business cases linked to shorter development cycles, reduced effort and improved product performance.
* Lead commercial proposals, negotiations and procurement processes.
* Coordinate Solution Engineering, Product, Forward Deployed Engineers and leadership around strategic opportunities.
* Maintain a healthy pipeline, accurate forecasts and disciplined opportunity management.
* Represent Neural Concept at customer meetings, executive briefings and industry events.


 Who you are
   

  

 You are an enterprise seller who combines commercial drive, strategic thinking and enough technical understanding to build credibility with engineering-led customers. You are comfortable creating opportunities in an emerging market, helping customers move from technical interest and pilot projects to enterprise adoption.
   

  

**Experience And Qualifications**
* At least five years of successful sales experience in enterprise software.
* Deep understanding of how engineering software adds value to product development in discrete industries (Automotive, Aerospace and Defense, High-Tech and Electronics)
* Broad knowledge of CAE, CAD, PLM, data platforms and cloud infrastructure is an important plus.
* Experience with AI is particularly relevant.
* Confidence selling business transformation and measurable value to senior executives.
* Experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
* Demonstrated success closing large software agreements and a consistent record of achieving or exceeding sales targets.
* Strong new-business development skills.
* Strong account planning, qualification, negotiation and forecasting skills.
* Professional fluency in Swedish and English.
* Willingness to travel regularly.


 How you work
   

  

* Driven and resilient
* Strategic and consultative
* Technically curious
* Credible at executive level
* Relationship-oriented
* Collaborative and accountable
* Comfortable in a fast-growing scale-up environment


 What we offer
   

  

* The opportunity to shape a new category at the intersection of AI and engineering.
* A differentiated technology platform with significant customer impact.
* Exposure to leading global engineering and manufacturing companies.
* Meaningful ownership in a rapidly growing international company.
* Competitive compensation with performance-based upside.
* Flexible and hybrid working arrangements.
* Strong opportunities for professional development and career progression.


 We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

title: Specialist inom Lumera eller på väg att bli det
description:
* Ansök senast: 16 augusti 2026
* Hybrid


 Arbetsuppgifter
   

  

*Lockas du av att arbeta med IT-drift, förstå system på djupet och lösa problem som verkligen gör skillnad, där teknik och verksamhet möts varje dag? Vill du dessutom jobba på ett kontor precis vid Centralen? Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med och ta ansvar för Lumera framåt, oavsett om du redan kan systemet eller vill lära dig det hos oss.*
 Lumera är ett av våra viktigaste system och en central del av hur vi skapar trygghet för våra kunder. Här möts teknik och verksamhet varje dag, och det arbete vi gör kring systemet märks på riktigt.
   

  

 Hos oss blir du snabbt en del av ett engagerat team där vi ställer upp för varandra och jobbar tätt tillsammans. Vi har olika specialistområden, men delar samma ansvar för att få helheten att fungera. Det är naturligt att be om hjälp, dela kunskap och lösa saker tillsammans, och det är också så vi utvecklas.
   

  

 AMF är ett mindre bolag, vilket gör att du inte försvinner i mängden. Din kompetens syns och uppskattas, och du får möjlighet att påverka både arbetssätt och lösningar. Vi tror på att bygga vår egen kompetens över tid och satsar på att utveckla våra medarbetare till specialister, samtidigt som vi samarbetar nära med både konsulter och leverantör.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 I rollen arbetar du operativt med Lumera och ansvarar tillsammans med teamet för att driften fungerar som den ska i vardagen. Arbetet är varierat och kombinerar löpande drift med analys och förbättringsarbete över tid.
   

  

 Du arbetar i både test- och produktionsmiljö och rör dig mellan olika typer av uppgifter beroende på vad som händer i systemet. Det kan handla om att planera och följa upp körningar, säkerställa att flöden går enligt plan, felsöka incidenter, genomföra installationer eller arbeta med databasen. En del av arbetet innebär också att analysera avvikelser, optimera prestanda och ta fram underlag som bidrar till vidare utveckling.
   

  

 Arbetet inkluderar även viss schemalagd kvälls- och helginsats, vilket planeras gemensamt i teamet.
   

  

**Vi erbjuder dig**
 Hos Oss Får Du En Bred Och Varierad Roll Hos En Arbetsgivare Formad Av Prestigelöshet Och Vänlighet. Det Innebär Till Exempel
   

  

* Ett meningsfullt uppdrag – hos oss bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för 4.5 miljoner människor, i ett bolag där samhällsnytta och långsiktighet står i centrum.
* En kultur där din kompetens tas tillvara – vi värdesätter din expertis och ger dig möjlighet att påverka, utveckla och dela med dig av din kunskap.
* Ett hållbart arbetsliv – hos oss får du balans, flexibilitet och goda förmåner som gör att du kan må bra både på och utanför jobbet.


 Kvalifikationer
   

  

**Lite mer om dig**
 Vi söker dig som antingen redan kan Lumera och vill fortsätta utvecklas som specialist, eller dig som arbetar med drift idag och är nyfiken på att ta nästa steg genom att lära dig Lumera hos oss. Du kanske är systemförvaltare eller applikationsspecialist och vill bredda din kompetens i en mer tekniskt fördjupad roll. Du har en stabil teknisk grund och känner dig bekväm i miljöer där databaser är en naturlig del av vardagen, exempelvis SQL Server, där du hanterar grundläggande uppgifter som backup, restore och enklare felsökning.
   

  

 Vidare trivs du nära tekniken och motiveras av att få saker att fungera i praktiken. Du tar ansvar, driver arbetet framåt och har ett naturligt driv i att både lösa problem här och nu och förbättra för framtiden. Samtidigt är du en lagspelare som bidrar till helheten, delar med dig av din kunskap och bygger goda samarbeten. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska.
   

  

 Vi tror på långsiktighet, men också på utveckling. I en vardag där AI och nya tekniker blir en allt större del av vårt arbete behöver vi vara både stabila och nyfikna. Hos oss innebär det att du är öppen för att arbetsuppgifter kan förändras över tid, att du vågar testa nytt och att du ser lärande som en naturlig del av jobbet. Vi värdesätter ett positivt förhållningssätt, flexibilitet och viljan att tillsammans utforska nya sätt att arbeta.
   

  

**Din ansökan**
 Vi arbetar kompetensbaserat och använder oss av arbetspsykologiska tester som en del i urvalsprocessen. Allt för att säkerställa en fördomsfri och rättvis rekryteringsprocess. Personligt brev behövs inte, men vi vill att du bifogar ditt CV och gärna att du svarar på några frågor vi ställer i samband med att du söker. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.
   

  

*Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!*

**Dina arbetsuppgifter**

 På Eccera får du de verktyg du behöver för att nå dina mål. Vi erbjuder alla våra konsulter kvalificerade utbildningar och certifieringar inom den senaste tekniken. title: Unreal Gameplay Programmer
description:
**Company Overview**
 Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.
   

  

 Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.
   

  

 At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.
   

  

 Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.
   

  

**Group Overview**
 The Digital and Synthetic Capability Unit (D&S) is committed to providing mission-driven information solutions that seamlessly bridge the digital and physical realms. Leveraging cutting-edge technologies and advanced platforms, we empower operational readiness and elevate situational awareness across diverse domains—including air, maritime, and space.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are looking for an experienced Unreal Engine programmer to join our NOR Core Platform team. In this role, you will have a major impact on our next generation simulation platform by developing core systems and features that create an immersive world with realistic and rich behaviours. You will have input into key architectural decisions whilst working closely with experts in rendering, game AI, flight dynamics, and test automation. You will report to an engineering manager and support them with technical decision making.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Develop and evolve a wide range of systems for our Unreal Engine-based simulation platform, including gameplay systems, cameras, UI, game AI, networking, and others.
* Advance the architecture of the platform, systems, and plugins to improve the usability by internal and external users.
* Improve testability at the functional and system levels.
* Help with upgrades to latest engine versions, driving the evaluation and adoption of new features.
* Ensure code quality and promote good engineering practices.
* Collaborate and communicate with the wider teams, articulating technical issues to non-technical team members.
* Regularly share knowledge, mentoring and onboarding other team members.


**What You Bring**
* 7+ years of professional C++ software development.
* Demonstrated deep experience creating and maintaining gameplay systems in Unreal Engine.
* Good knowledge of UI systems and design patterns.
* Applied architectural principles that ensure extensibility, maintainability, and performance.
* Experience of team delivery in an Agile software development environment.
* Strong organizational skills: able to work independently; proactive approach to task delivery and documentation.
* Drive to learn constantly and further your knowledge.


**Additional Eligibility Qualifications**
* Experience with game AI systems.


**Benefits**
 Friskvård of 5K annually
   

  

 Parental leave
   

  

 5% occupational pension (swe. tjänstepension),
   

  

 30 days of leave
   

  

 Bonus Scheme
   

  

 Personal development opportunities
   

  

**Work Authorization / Security Clearance**
 The candidate will have the legal right to work in Sweden and will be able to produce right to work documentation.
   

  

**AAP/EEO Statement**
 Metrea is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.
   

  

**Position Type and Expected Hours of Work**
 This is a full-time non-exempt position with typical working hours of Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Hours and work shifts may change in accordance with department and business needs. Exempt Employees must have the ability to be on-call and available, as business needs require. Non-Exempt employees may be required to work over 40 hours per week with approval from the department manager.
   

  

**Work Environment**
 The job operates in an office setting.
   

  

**Travel**
 This role may require occasional travel to other Metrea offices.
   

  

**Our Firmware**
 At Metrea, our single core value is Rooted in Humility, and our four cornerstone attributes are Entrepreneurial, Systematic, Discerning, and Over-Deliver. These form what we call our Teammate Firmware. Just like technical firmware connects software and hardware, our Firmware is the constant interface between our mission and our people. It defines how we show up, how we work together, and how we solve complex problems.
   

  

 Our team Firmware creates a web-like, hyper-collaborative, dynamically hierarchical way of working that helps us adapt quickly, communicate openly, and distribute decision-making to where expertise actually lives. It enables groups to self-organize around hard problems, shift fluidly as priorities evolve, and operate with the trust, curiosity, and discipline required in a complex mission space. This foundation allows us to deliver elegant, effective solutions and uphold our purpose: protecting our precious inheritance.

title: Pharmaceutical Sales Representative
description:
**Kenvue Is Currently Recruiting For a**
 Pharmaceutical Sales Representative
   

  

**What We Do**
 At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including NEUTROGENA®, AVEENO®, TYLENOL®, LISTERINE®, JOHNSON’S® and BAND-AID® that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Our global team is ~ 22,000 brilliant people with a workplace culture where every voice matters, and every contribution is appreciated. We are passionate about insights, innovation and committed to delivering the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means having the power to impact millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours. For more information, click here.
   

  

**Role Reports To**
 General Manager Nordics
   

  

**Location:**
 Europe/Middle East/Africa, Sweden, Stockholm, Solna
   

  

**Work Location:**
 Hybrid
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Our products are part of everyday life, often without people even thinking about it. From a morning routine with Listerine, to skincare with Neutrogena, pain relief with Ipren, or supporting a smoke‑free journey with Nicorette, our brands are trusted by millions of people around the world. Behind these well-known products is a team driven by one purpose: to realize the extraordinary power of everyday care.
   

  

 As Pharmaceutical Sales Representative this means working with a portfolio of trusted brands that healthcare professionals already know and rely on. Your role is not just to promote products, but to act as a knowledgeable partner, supporting HCPs with relevant insights, education, and solutions that truly add value in their daily work. By building strong relationships and understanding customer needs, you play a key role in bringing these brands to life in the field and making a real difference for both healthcare professionals and patients
   

  

 At Kenvue, you’re not just representing products, you’re representing everyday care that people depend on.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with HCPs (pharmacists, physicians, dentists, etc.)
* Act as a trusted advisor by delivering high-quality product information and educational sessions
* Deliver effective and high-quality product presentations and educational sessions.
* Plan and execute local HCP meetings and educational events
* Identify customer needs and tailor your approach to create value
* Take ownership of your territory and contribute to achieving sales and market share goals
* Capture and share market insights, customer feedback, and competitor activities
* Maintain accurate documentation in CRM systems
* Collaborate closely with marketing, medical, and commercial teams to align activities and campaigns
* Contribute to the development and execution of local account and HCP plans


**Required**
* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Business, or similar
* Experience in pharma, OTC, or healthcare-related sales
* LIF certification (or other equivalent educational background)
* Good understanding of compliance and industry regulations
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills
* Ability to work independently in a field-based role
* Fluency in Swedish and English
* Willingness to travel within your region


*Due to the summer holiday period, there may be a delay in feedback. The selection process will begin in mid-August.*
 If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

title: Commercial Product Manager (Customer Service Software)
description:
**Would you like to take commercial ownership of** 
**Customer Service Software and work at the intersection of customer dialogue, sales, and product development?** 




  





 Nice to meet you! I'm Milja Valentine, a Senior Talent Partner at LeadDesk. Together with Mikko Räty, our Head of Product, we're looking for a Commercial Product Manager to join our Product team.
 



  





 This is a highly commercial Product role. We are looking for someone who enjoys working directly with customers, supporting strategic sales opportunities, and translating customer needs into commercial product success. We have several cloud-based Customer Service solutions built for companies that take customer dialogue seriously. Our solutions covers communication across channels including voice webchat, email, chatbot, social media, and SMS. You can read more at www.leaddesk.com.
 



  





 You will work closely with customers, sales, and the product team, owning the commercial product agenda for selected Customer Service solutions. The role is built around the person we hire, and depending on your background it can for example include team leadership responsibility. This is a new role and can be based in our Helsinki, Oslo, or Stockholm office.
 



  





**What's in it for you** 




  




* A new role with real ownership. You will define the commercial product direction for solutions and build the role from the ground up
* Work on products that solves real, everyday problems for customer service organisations across Europe
* Be part of a publicly listed SaaS company that builds its own technology and keeps investing in product and innovation
* Join a collaborative product team that gets things done and enjoys working together
* Collaborate with colleagues from 27 nationalities across 7 countries in a truly international work environment
* Flexible and hybrid. Enjoy work-life balance with flexible hours and a hybrid model, with 3 days a week at the office



  





**What you can expect as a Commercial Product Manager at LeadDesk** 




  





 You will be the commercial counterpart to the technical product manager, owning the business side of product development. This means staying close to customers and sales, setting commercial priorities, and making sure the product moves in a direction that creates real customer and business value.
 



  




* Taking commercial ownership, including positioning, packaging, and go-to-market readiness
* Actively supporting Sales in strategic customer meetings, leading product demonstrations when needed, and helping win complex commercial opportunities by translating product capabilities into customer value
* Acting as the commercial face of the product in customer meetings and becoming a trusted advisor for both customers and the Sales organization
* Working closely with customers and sales to understand needs and translate them into clear product direction
* Coordinating and prioritising commercial input together with the technical product team
* Working with product, sales, and customer success to drive commercial performance and customer satisfaction
* Owning pricing models and driving the commercial development of the product area



  





**What success looks like in this role in the first 6 months and beyond** 




  




* You have built strong working relationships with customers, sales, and the product team, and are the natural go-to for commercial product questions
* Sales actively involve you in strategic customer opportunities because your commercial expertise helps win business
* Customers recognize you as a trusted advisor who understands both their business challenges and how LeadDesk products create value
* Commercial priorities are clear, well-structured, and flow effectively into the product team
* You have taken full ownership of the role and are driving it forward with confidence
* Commercial performance of products is heading in the right direction, or you have a clear plan to get it there



  





**This is where the match happens** 




**Must-haves** 




  




* Experience in at least one of the following commercial product management, B2B software sales, pre-sales, solution consulting, business development, or similar customer-facing commercial roles
* Strong commercial mindset with the ability to identify customer opportunities and confidently present product value to executive stakeholders.
* Ability to turn customer and sales input into structured, actionable product priorities
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with hands-on experience working with KPIs, reporting, and business data
* Experience working cross-functionally with both commercial and technical stakeholders
* Ability to bring structure and ownership into an environment where the role is still being defined
* Relevant degree in a commercial or technical field
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken



  





**Nice-to-haves** 




  




* Previous experience with contact center, customer service software, or similar solutions
* Background in scale-up or international B2B SaaS environments
* Experience in SaaS sales, pre-sales, solution consulting, or commercial product roles where customer interaction has been a significant part of the job
* Fluency in any additional European language (e.g., Finnish, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Dutch, German, Spanish) is considered an advantage



  





**Practicalities** 




  




* Location: Helsinki, Stockholm, or Oslo (hybrid work model, 3 days a week at the office)
* Travel: Regular travel within the Nordics and Europe. Depending on business needs, travel may be required weekly or monthly.
* Start date: As agreed. The sooner, the better.
* Employment: Full-time, permanent
* Base salary: 5 000–7 000 EUR/month (or local currency equivalent)
* Performance-based bonus: On-target earnings (OTE) of approximately €10,000–15,000 annually



  





**What's next?** 




  





 Submit your application by the 15th of August 2026. We're reviewing applications continuously, so don't wait too long!
 



  





 If you have questions, please contact Milja Valentine from the Talent team at milja.valentine(at)leaddesk.com.
 



  





***About LeadDesk***




  





 At LeadDesk, our purpose is to simplify human connections between organisations and people across Europe. Our cloud platform is a single solution for outbound sales, inbound sales, and customer service, enabling hundreds of millions of customer interactions every year.
 



  





 When it comes to our employees, we believe that each of us is a Leader. Someone with a lot of ambition, drive, and readiness to take (and receive!) ownership from day 1. You're now part of an exciting journey, helping LeadDesk become Europe's most trusted AI-driven, voice-first customer interaction platform.
 



  





 We welcome people from all backgrounds and walks of life. Our people represent a wide range of cultures, nationalities, and perspectives. We hire based on skills and potential, and we're committed to providing equal opportunity for all applicants.

title: IT Channel Marketing Senior Specialist
description:
At Eaton we are continuously striving to make our world safer, sustainable and efficient in power management. We believe in our employees and we can achieve our goals together. We make what matters work! Join us and help us provide energy-efficient solutions that make a real impact. Find out more about Eaton!
   

  

 As IT Channel Marketing Senior Specialist you will be responsible for executing channel marketing strategies that drive growth and engagement through the IT channel partners in the pre-defined territory of Nordics, in line with the local business strategy. You will be member of the EMEA IT channel marketing community, and collaborates with the local IT Channel sales, as well as EMEA Field Product Marketing, Product Marcom and Demand Generation Marketing teams to support the development of the Eaton’s IT channel business and growth ambitions.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* With the support of the Direct Manager and in line with the local IT sales team:
+ develop and execute marketing communication activities targeting IT partners as a part of the commercial IT Partner Program in the predefined territory, in line with the EMEA IT partner program framework.
+ cooperate closely with the local IT sales team and targeted IT partners, develop and execute annual channel marketing plans (MDF) to support sales objectives and drive IT partners engagement.
+ develop a cohesive contact data strategy to enable segmentation and targeting of contacts and work with Sales to ensure that their use of Salesforce for contacts and accounts facilitates richer customer engagement.

* Localize and manage marketing enablement and promotional materials, including digital content.
* With the support of the direct manager, plan and execute IT partner events, webinars, and other activities to drive partner engagement and lead generation.
* Contribute to the push/ pull campaigns and align Tier 1 activities with Tier 2 campaigns to help generate the adequate demand for Eaton offers, and maximize sellout of the partner inventories (including promotions, incentives...)
* Monitor and report on the effectiveness of To- and Through-Channel marketing activities (MDF), making data-driven recommendations for improvement.
* With the support of the direct manager, manage the IT channel marketing budgets, ensuring efficient allocation of resources.
* Consolidate relationships with key local IT partners, ensuring marketing alignment on goals and strategies.
* Support the Digital transformation of the IT partners by promoting the adoption of new collaborative tools (MyEaton, PRM, e-commerce, APIs...)
* Monitor IT Partner satisfaction regularly, and help make Eaton their partner of choice.
* Contribute to collecting market trends and feedbacks on competitor activities to identify new growth opportunities through the channel.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor Degree in Marketing/Communication/Business school.
* Relevant (3-5 years) experience in marketing communication, preferably in B2B and channel marketing.
* Execution of joint marketing activities with partners (campaign planning - setting up KPIs, execution of program, MDF management, reporting and analysis).
* Understanding of marketing disciplines, knowledge of channel business processes is an advantage (channel business strategy, commercial approach, distribution models etc).
* Experience in partner program planning and deployment (acquire, retain, develop and enable) is an advantage.
* Experience in channel partner programs and cooperation with EWS companies is an advantage.
* Experience working with international cross-functional teams in a dynamic, matrixed environment is an advantage
* Customer-focused attitude, ability to learn fast and curiosity, digital and data-driven mindset.
* Good written and verbal communications skills in English, business level language knowledge in one of the Nordic languages (Norwegian, Swedish, Danish, Finnish).
* Able to work and travel in EMEA/EU region without any restrictions.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive compensation, annual bonus, benefits package as per the local country standards.
* Permanent contract in a fast-growing global company.
* Challenging projects in dynamic collaborative team.
* Hybrid working setup.
* We make ethics and culture matter – You will enjoy working in supportive and collaborative workplace where ethics and safety are in our DNA.
* We make your aspirations matter – Eaton encourages internal promotion, whenever possible.
* We make your contributions matter - reliability, safety, efficiency, and sustainability are at the core of our dedication to improving people’s lives and the environment through power management technologies.
* We make your voice matter - we value safety and trust. This is a place where you can speak up and be heard. There’s room here for everyone because we believe that every person matters.


 All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.
   

  

 We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

title: CRM Solutions Development Consultant
description:

 Avanade arbetar med att utveckla och implementera lösningar baserade på Dynamics 365 för organisationer i olika branscher. Genom djup kompetens inom Microsofts plattform och erfarenhet av verksamhetsnära projekt hjälper vi våra kunder att använda teknik för att effektivisera arbetssätt och skapa affärsnytta.
   

  

 Som D365 Customer Engagement (CE) Developer arbetar du med att designa och utveckla CRM-lösningar genom hela projektets livscykel. Du samarbetar nära projektledare, funktionella konsulter, arkitekter och andra utvecklare för att säkerställa att lösningen möter både tekniska krav och verksamhetens behov.
   

  

 Rollen passar dig som har god teknisk kompetens inom Dynamics 365 CE och vill arbeta i projekt där kvalitet, struktur och samarbete är centralt.
   

  

**Ansvarsområden**
* Rådgiva kunder och interna intressenter kring hur teknik kan användas för att lösa affärsproblem
* Utveckla applikationer, skriva och underhålla komplex kod samt genomföra tester och komponentdesign

**Qualifications**

* Erfarenhet av att analysera, designa, utveckla, anpassa, konfigurera, implementera och förvalta applikationskod i Microsoft Dynamics CRM och Power Platform, särskilt inom Sales och Customer Service.
* Erfarenhet av arbete i Software-as-a-Service (SaaS)-miljöer samt med Microsoft SQL Server, HTML, JavaScript, Microsoft ASP, Microsoft .NET och Azure DevOps.
* Erfarenhet av att integrera och anpassa workflows med Copilot Studio för att bygga konversationsbaserade AI-lösningar och automatisera affärsprocesser.
* Förmåga att arbeta kundnära och tillsammans med kund ta fram och följa en handlingsplan.

* Kandidatexamen inom datavetenskap, datateknik, systemvetenskap, Management Information Systems, eller motsvarande, alternativt relevant arbetslivserfarenhet..


**Personliga egenskaper vi tror att du har för att lyckas i rollen**

It’s all here, so take a closer look!

 Inspire greatness in our people by

* Celebrating progress


 Accelerate the impact of our people by

* Prioritizing what matters
